about_the_game:
The Hambagu Shop is a cozy horror narrative simulator where you work in a Japanese Hamburg Steak Shop.

You play as Mari, a teenage girl who work in a popular hamburg steak shop branch and was promoted to branch manager.

Demo Version

In this demo, you will experience working a single night shift at The Hambagu Shop, a cozy little Japanese restaurant known for its famous Hamburg Rice Bowl.

Average play time for the demo is 5 to 10 minutes.

During your first night shift, your boss will brief you on the simple steps of making a delicious Hamburg Rice Bowl, along with the basic manners of customer service.

You will grill the meat, scoop the rice, and top it off with a soft pasteurized egg before serving it to your customers.

It sounds simple enough. Take the order, cook, serve, and repeat until your shift ends.

But as the night goes on, something about the shop feels off.

Features

Gameplay: a simple yet engaging loop, grill hamburg, prepare side dishes and serve customers.

VHS Aesthetics: Experience the game through a creepy VHS filter that adds a nostalgic and eerie atmosphere.

Story: Get a small glimpse into Mari's personal story in this demo, and uncover her mystery with the full game.

For Content Creators

You are free to create content from the game and monetize the gameplay by any means. There are no other restrictions from my side when playing the game

content_descriptors.notes: This demo contains subtle hint or depression and mental illness.
